data.name: ExtensionsAutoFormatLabel.ToolTip
data.value: Automatically format the extensions text box to the preferred format once the text box is deselected.

data.name: RequestedThumbnailSizesLabel.ToolTip
data.value:
Determines which thumbnail sizes the preloader will request from Windows.
The selected thumbnail sizes may not be guaranteed depending on Windows.
Selecting multiple thumbnail sizes will cause the preloader to run slower.

data.name: PreloadFolderIconsForLabel.ToolTip
data.value:
Selecting "Folders Containing Set Extensions" will ensure that only folders that contain files that have the specified extensions will have their icons included to be preloaded.
Selecting "All Folders" will add all folders to the preloader which may cause freezes when adding certain system folders.

data.name: PreloaderProcessPriorityLabel.ToolTip
data.value:
Determines the process priority used by the thumbnail preloader.
The recommended default is "Below Normal" for best system responsiveness while preloading thumbnails in the background.

data.name: WaitAfterCacheBackupCheckBox.ToolTip
data.value:
Determines whether the progress dialog should stay open after cache backup and for how long it should stay open for.
This setting will override the "Wait After Preloading Completion" value if Auto Backup is enabled and a cache backup occurs.
A value of 0 seconds while enabled prevents auto closing, and waits indefinitely until it is manually cancelled or closed.

data.name: ProgressDialogUpdateSpeedLabel.ToolTip
data.value:
Determines how often the progress bar updates while preloading.
Slower values can help consume less resources, while faster values can show new information faster, but may consume more resources.

data.name: WaitAfterPreloadingCompletionCheckBox.ToolTip
data.value:
Determines whether the progress dialog should stay open after preloading and for how long it should stay open for.
This setting will be overridden by the "Wait For Cache Backup" value if Auto Backup is enabled and a cache backup occurs.
A value of 0 seconds while enabled prevents auto closing, and waits indefinitely until it is manually cancelled or closed.

data.name: LoggingFrequencyLabel.ToolTip
data.value:
Enables various tiers of logging for various purposes.
No Logging: Disables all logging.
Preloader Logging: Enables logging for the preloader which includes basic logging of argument parsing and directory scanning along with certain errors.
GUI Logging: Enables logging for the GUI forms which includes basic logging of interactions and certain errors.
All Logging: Enables logging for both the preloader and the GUI which includes basic logging of actions and errors.
Debug Logging: Enables logging for both the preloader and the GUI which includes logging for almost every action, many variables, and every error that occurs, big or small. (More detailed logging available in single-threaded mode)
Enabling Debug Logging may cause the application to run slower, especially while preloading, and may use more storage.

data.name: AutoDeleteLogsByAgeCheckBox.ToolTip
data.value: Selects whether to delete old log files after a selected number of days.

data.name: ClearLoggerFolderButton.ToolTip
data.value: Clears the backup path and disables all logging features.

data.name: DefaultLoggerFolderButton.ToolTip
data.value:
Sets the Logs Folder to the default folder, depending on how the program is installed/located.
If the program is installed in a restricted folder such as in Program Files, the default location will be in AppData.
If the program is ran portably or installed in a non-restricted folder, the default location will be in the same directory as the program.

data.name: LogButton.ToolTip
data.value: Opens the folder where the log files are stored. Holding "SHIFT" will ask to clear all log files.
